verses.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ بِيَدِهِ الۡمُلۡكُؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرُۙ‏
verses.en: Blessed be He in Whose hands is Dominion; and He over all things hath Power

verses.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡمَوۡتَ وَالۡحَيٰوةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ اَيُّكُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًاؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفُوۡرُۙ‏
verses.en: He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاؕ مَا تَرٰي فِيۡ خَلۡقِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡ تَفٰوُتٍؕ فَارۡجِعِ الۡبَصَرَۙ هَلۡ تَرٰي مِنۡ فُطُوۡرٍ
verses.en: He Who created the seven heavens one above another: No want of proportion wilt thou see in the Creation of (Allah) Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again: seest thou any flaw

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ارۡجِعِ الۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنۡقَلِبۡ اِلَيۡكَ الۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Again turn thy vision a second time: (thy) vision will come back to thee dull and discomfited, in a state worn out

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَابِيۡحَ وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا رُجُوۡمًا لِّلشَّيٰطِيۡنِ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ السَّعِيۡرِ
verses.en: And we have, (from of old), adorned the lowest heaven with Lamps, and We have made such (Lamps) (as) missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, and have prepared for them the Penalty of the Blazing Fire

verses.ar: وَلِلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
verses.en: For those who reject their Lord (and Cherisher) is the Penalty of Hell: and evil is (such), Destination

verses.ar: اِذَا٘ اُلۡقُوۡا فِيۡهَا سَمِعُوۡا لَهَا شَهِيۡقًا وَّهِيَ تَفُوۡرُۙ‏
verses.en: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath even as it blazes forth

verses.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الۡغَيۡظِؕ كُلَّمَا٘ اُلۡقِيَ فِيۡهَا فَوۡجٌ سَاَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا٘ اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلٰي قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ ࣢ۙ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍۚۖ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِيۡرٍ
verses.en: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'Allah never sent down any (Message): ye are nothing but an egregious delusion

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ اَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيۡ٘ اَصۡحٰبِ السَّعِيۡرِ
verses.en: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not (now) be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire

verses.ar: فَاعۡتَرَفُوۡا بِذَنۭۡ بِهِمۡۚ فَسُحۡقًا لِّاَصۡحٰبِ السَّعِيۡرِ
verses.en: They will then confess their sins: but far will be (Forgiveness) from the Companions of the Blazing Fire

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَيۡبِ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ كَبِيۡرٌ
verses.en: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward

verses.ar: وَاَسِرُّوۡا قَوۡلَكُمۡ اَوِ اجۡهَرُوۡا بِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
verses.en: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, of the secrets of (all) hearts

verses.ar: اَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَؕ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيۡفُ الۡخَبِيۡرُࣖ‏
verses.en: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries (and) is well-acquainted (with them)

verses.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ ذَلُوۡلًا فَامۡشُوۡا فِيۡ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوۡا مِنۡ رِّزۡقِهٖؕ وَاِلَيۡهِ النُّشُوۡرُ
verses.en: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection

verses.ar: ءَاَمِنۡتُمۡ مَّنۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اَنۡ يَّخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَمُوۡرُۙ‏
verses.en: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)

verses.ar: اَمۡ اَمِنۡتُمۡ مَّنۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اَنۡ يُّرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبًاؕ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيۡرِ
verses.en: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones), so that ye shall know how (terrible) was My warning

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيۡرِ
verses.en: But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَي الطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صٰٓفّٰتٍ وَّيَقۡبِضۡنَؔۘؕ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحۡمٰنُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍۭ بَصِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except (Allah) Most Gracious: Truly (Allah) Most Gracious: Truly it is He that watches over all things

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ هُوَ جُنۡدٌ لَّكُمۡ يَنۡصُرُكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِؕ اِنِ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ غُرُوۡرٍۚ‏
verses.en: Nay, who is there that can help you, (even as) an army, besides (Allah) Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ اِنۡ اَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهٗۚ بَلۡ لَّجُّوۡا فِيۡ عُتُوٍّ وَّنُفُوۡرٍ
verses.en: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight (from the Truth)

verses.ar: اَفَمَنۡ يَّمۡشِيۡ مُكِبًّا عَلٰي وَجۡهِهٖ٘ اَهۡدٰ٘ي اَمَّنۡ يَّمۡشِيۡ سَوِيًّا عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way

verses.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡشَاَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give

verses.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ الَّذِيۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡعِلۡمُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِࣕ وَاِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةً سِيۡٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوۡهُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَقِيۡلَ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوۡنَ
verses.en: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَهۡلَكَنِيَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعِيَ اَوۡ رَحِمَنَاۙ فَمَنۡ يُّجِيۡرُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty

verses.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۚ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرًا فَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِمَآءٍ مَّعِيۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water
